author: G. A. Richardson
title: Rep. Andy Harris calls for tougher action on Baltimore crime via social media posts
text:
Andy Harris U.S. House of Representatives from Maryland's 1st district | Official U.S. House Headshot
Andy Harris U.S. House of Representatives from Maryland's 1st district | Official U.S. House Headshot
Rep. Andy Harris, currently serving as the U.S. Congressman for Maryland’s 1st district, posted a series of statements on his social media account in early September 2025 criticizing Democratic leadership in Baltimore and calling for stronger federal intervention to address crime and public safety.
On September 2, 2025, Harris wrote: "President Trump is right—decades of failed liberal Democrat leadership have left Baltimore plagued by crime, poverty, and neglect. The federal government has not just the right, but the duty, to step in to enforce the law when local leaders won’t act to keep Americans safe in https://t.co/KEKGQn2yWU".
The following morning on September 3, Harris announced a scheduled television appearance with: " Coming up on @FOXBaltimore at 7AM. I’ll be talking about the crime crisis in Baltimore, how failed leadership got us here, and why it’s time for real solutions to restore safety and law & order for our communities. Tune in!"
Later that day he reiterated his stance on public safety issues: "Democrats have ignored the crime crisis while Baltimore families pay the price. Americans deserve safety in their homes and streets. It’s time to get tough on crime, hold offenders accountable, and restore law & order. Baltimore can’t afford more failure. https://t.co/ej34JXm7cj"
Harris has represented Maryland's 1st district since replacing Frank Kratovil in Congress in 2011. Prior to his congressional tenure, he served in both the Maryland House of Representatives and Senate from 1999 until joining Congress.
He was born in New York City in 1957 and resides in Cambridge.
Harris earned his undergraduate degree from Johns Hopkins University.
